props.title: Security Digest — 2026-10-07
props.description: 3 confirmed exploited (KEV), 5 to patch this week, 3 to monitor. Sources: KEV, GH Advisory, EPSS

props.title: CVE-2026-104286 — Fortinet FortiMail
props.message:
KEV 2026-10-01 · EPSS 0.022 · CVSS —

Unauth path traversal → arbitrary file write via crafted HTTP/HTTPS. Active exploitation confirmed.

Action: upgrade FortiMail per vendor advisory; BOD 26-04 deadline passed.

props.title: CVE-2026-76504 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
props.message:
KEV 2026-09-30 · EPSS 0.018 · CVSS —

Hex-encoded URI bypass grants unauth remote admin access. Active exploitation confirmed.

Action: upgrade SD-WAN Manager per Cisco advisory; BOD 26-04 deadline passed.

props.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad
props.message:
KEV 2026-10-02 · EPSS 0.014 · CVSS —

Session fixation → RCE as zammad user; chains with CVE-2026-102490 (priv esc → root).

Action: upgrade Zammad per vendor advisory; BOD 26-04 deadline passed.

props.title: GHSA-pq68-rvw4-xp4r — vm2 (npm)
props.message:
CVSS 10.0 · EPSS 0.007 · no patch

Sandbox escape, all vm2 ≤3.12.0. Project unmaintained.

Action: replace vm2 with isolated-vm or native Node worker_threads now.

props.title: GHSA-r543-q48m-4c9j — WeasyPrint (pip)
props.message:
CVSS 8.8 · EPSS 0.007 · no patch

EPS images route through Ghostscript → RCE. All versions ≤69.0 affected.

Action: block EPS input to WeasyPrint; disable Ghostscript path until patch lands.

props.title: GHSA-g2v8-7jhw-pp8p — @backstage/plugin-scaffolder-backend (npm)
props.message:
CVSS 9.6 · EPSS 0.005

Sensitive info exposure in Scaffolder. Lead advisory of a 10-advisory Backstage batch.

Action: upgrade plugin-scaffolder-backend ≥4.1.0 and plugin-techdocs-node ≥1.15.4.

props.title: GHSA-qmw3-745m-w99g — @backstage/plugin-techdocs-node (npm)
props.message:
CVSS 8.8 · EPSS —

Improper MkDocs config validation; 5 related TechDocs CVEs in same release.

Action: upgrade plugin-techdocs-node ≥1.15.4 (fixes all TechDocs batch CVEs).

props.title: GHSA-826h-28h9-65hg — @backstage/plugin-auth-backend-module-oidc-provider (npm)
props.message:
CVSS 8.1 · EPSS 0.003

Improper OIDC auth; affects OIDC-based SSO flows.

Action: upgrade plugin-auth-backend-module-oidc-provider ≥0.4.20.

props.title: GHSA-c3wx-c55w-pxjq — hydra-core (pip)
props.message:
CVSS 7.8 · EPSS 0.002

Unsafe callable resolution in logging config; code exec path.

Action: schedule upgrade: hydra-core → ≥1.3.6.

props.title: GHSA-jg6q-3qfh-r9f8 — @insumermodel/mppx-condition-gate (npm)
props.message:
CVSS 7.5 · EPSS 0.003

Wallet access without ownership proof; no patch.

Action: track; avoid mppx-condition-gate/mppx-token-gate until patched.

props.title: GHSA-cq7v-rfgc-5c7v — @backstage/backend-defaults (npm)
props.message:
CVSS 7.6 · EPSS 0.002

Credential delegation drops access restrictions.

Action: schedule upgrade: @backstage/backend-defaults → ≥0.17.8.
